tools.name: check_cbp_drawback_eligibility
tools.description: Check US CBP duty drawback statutory scope, 8-digit HTSUS/Schedule B alignment, and 5-year lookback window readiness under 19 U.S.C. 1313. Read-only diagnostic gate; zero duty refund calculations.

tools.name: check_eu_cbam_eudr_mandate
tools.description: Check EU CBAM (Regulation (EU) 2023/956 and 2025/2083 50-tonne threshold) and EUDR (Regulation (EU) 2023/1115) CN/HS scope and WGS84 polygon rules. Read-only diagnostic gate; zero emissions math.

tools.name: check_irs_179d_cmmc_readiness
tools.description: Check IRS Section 179D (Form 7205) energy-efficient commercial building scope and DoD CMMC 2.0 / NIST SP 800-171 SPRS readiness. Read-only diagnostic gate; zero tax deduction math.

tools.name: check_uae_qfzp_gdpr_trigger
tools.description: Check UAE Corporate Tax QFZP 0% de-minimis cliff (Federal Decree-Law 47/2022 & MD 265/2023) and EU GDPR Art. 3/30/35 triggers. Read-only diagnostic gate; zero tax liability math.

tools.name: verify_titan_ed25519_workpaper_hash
tools.description: Verify SHA-256 digest and detached Ed25519 signature of a TITAN statutory workpaper against the published authority public key. Read-only offline cryptographic gate.
